source.name: Chiaroscuro Certainty
source.description: Your win or lose streak will not be terminated and when the relic disappears, you will receive a corresponding level loot token based on the highest reward/compensation held during that time.

descriptions.en: Your win or lose streak will not be terminated and when the relic disappears, you will receive a corresponding level loot token based on the highest reward/compensation held during that time.
descriptions.ru: Ваша серия побед или поражений не будет прервана, и когда реликвия исчезнет, вы получите жетон, уровень которого соответствует самой высокой награде/компенсации, полученной за это время.

notes: 2-4 win/loss streak corresponds to level (lapsed relic count) loot token, 5-9 win/loss streak corresponds to level (lapsed relic count+1) loot token, and 10+ win/loss streak corresponds to level (lapsed relic count+2) loot token.
The Maximum level of this token is level 5.
